blocks.body: Cause a FAILED run on purpose, quote the first real error, repair it, and rerun to SUCCESS.

blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 110 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: It must fail first
blocks.body:
Cause a real break. Apply the recipe. Read the log from the top. Quote the first human error. Open that file. Repair. Rerun.

Good quote: a line that names `inflate-the-kite.dita` (or whichever file you broke) and says well-formed or missing file.

Bad quote: `BUILD FAILED` with no cause.

items.title: Word today
items.body: **FAILED** :  the engine stopped. The quote is the first real error that names a file, not the last stack line.

blocks.title: DITA Map Completeness Check
watchFor: Missing path rows you might also see in a log

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: You never produced FAILED, or you quoted only ‘BUILD FAILED’ with no cause, or you left the copy broken, or you ‘fixed’ it by switching to a different booklet.

Expected: failed-first-error.txt has FAILED cause + SUCCESS confirmation. Check copy publishes.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Copy kitepump to oxygen-bootcamp-work/week6-failed/ so you can break a copy.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Break 1 (pick one): point a booklet line at a missing file, or delete a closing tag in a page the booklet includes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Run WebHelp Responsive. Status must be FAILED (if it still succeeds, break the booklet path until it fails).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Copy the first real error line (not a long technical dump at the bottom if a human line exists above it) into oxygen-bootcamp-work/week6/failed-first-error.txt.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Repair the copy. Rerun. SUCCESS. Quote the SUCCESS line under the error in the same file.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Write one sentence: the first place I looked was ____ (log, then the file it named).

blocks.summary: failed-first-error.txt has FAILED cause + SUCCESS confirmation. Check copy publishes.

blocks.q: The log ends with a long technical stack. Where is the first real error usually?
options: The last line of the stack
Higher :  an [ERROR] or engine message that names a file
blocks.why: Read from the first [ERROR] that names a file. The stack is the engine falling after that.

blocks.q: FAILED because a page is not well-formed. Completeness was clean yesterday. What is true?
options: Completeness always includes well-formedness of every file
Possible :  you broke the file after, or completeness did not read that file the same way
blocks.why: Run both. A new Text-mode break is a new error.
